role_and_message.evidence: The motivation remains single-view shape ambiguity and improved plausibility of unseen viewpoints with view priors.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: Both original chair rows retain the input image and all four reconstructed views; observed versus unobserved view grouping is preserved.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: Original 2D image, reconstructed model, original-viewpoint and unobserved-view labels are preserved or repeated for the second row; no quantitative claim is added.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Both image-to-reconstruction chevrons remain. Original bracket grouping separates one observed reconstruction from three unobserved views in each row.

visual_encodings.evidence: All chair texture, colour and shape defects are original pixels; red/blue row headings distinguish without/with prior rather than reclassifying individual shapes.

examples_and_data.evidence: Original chair rows and viewpoint brackets were independently compared to recorded source crops at native/recorded integer scale with exact hashes.

unsupported_additions.evidence: Matching one view being insufficient and discriminator-based view-prior explanation are explicitly supported by caption and pp1–2.

complete_visible_content.evidence: All original chairs and their silhouettes, textures and viewing relationships are fully visible; additional grouping does not conceal reconstruction failures.

remaining_limitations: Original examples, content and source resolution remain; new text is limited to original caption/body claims. Layout quality is assessed separately.
